API_01.scenario: A APPLIED, B UNKNOWN, C NOT_ATTEMPTED; original plan INTERRUPTED

normal_public_commit.signature: runtime.storage.commit_action_result(committed_intent, prepared_action, observation, comparison, *, owner_id, generation) -> ActionResultRecord
normal_public_commit.responsibility: During the original ACTIVE owner and RUNNING plan only: persist immutable a03-action-fact-1 resource first, then append ACTION_RESULT_COMMITTED with exact intent/obligation/action/readback/comparator binding. APPLIED/NOT_APPLIED can close only that current obligation; UNKNOWN stays pending. An interrupted/restarted intent must reconcile and cannot be finalized through this normal-run entry.
inputs: Current original committed intent and plan cursor
Actual independent per-action observation/readback and public A02 comparison
Current owner/generation; complete current book scan and event-head CAS
outputs: Immutable fact Resource with plan/intent/obligation/action digest, prepared_before, observed_snapshot_ref/readback, comparator_version, complete ActionResult and journal sequence/predecessor hash
Committed ActionResultRecord and progress projection; no new Artifact kind
normal_public_commit.compatibility: Normal multi-action runs can advance after an APPLIED committed per-action fact before a whole-plan receipt exists. Progress is a projection, never caller authority; NOT_APPLIED/UNKNOWN interrupts the old plan and the tail cannot resume.

recovery_public_commit.responsibility: Append RECONCILIATION_COMMITTED after verifying the exact original obligation, valid single chain head, actual fresh observation and current owner/event-head CAS. May write an explicit RECOVERY fact resource tied to resolution_ref; never use normal commit_action_result for a restarted intent or edit original UNKNOWN facts.
inputs: Current complete book unresolved set and original committed intent evidence
outputs: Committed resolution record, unchanged original history and new effective progress
Optional RECOVERY fact with original attempt_fact and exact resolution_ref; complete receipt only if every action has sufficient facts

API_01.reason: The supplied tail fact has no intent/obligation; the listed normal entry requires a committed intent and RUNNING cursor, while reconciliation requires original intent evidence. A public transaction path for this permitted fact remains unspecified. This is a design reading, not an executed API result.
